explore.title: Explore what you are experiencing.
explore.subtitle: Select any area that resonates with you to start a private reflection or browse specialists experienced in that domain.
explore.anxietyDesc: Racing thoughts, constant tension, or physical restlessness that feels difficult to quiet.
explore.sleepDesc: Trouble falling asleep, waking up in the middle of the night, or waking unrefreshed.
explore.stressDesc: Balancing responsibilities when demands feel too heavy and restorative downtime feels out of reach.
explore.moodDesc: Persistent emptiness, losing interest in activities you usually enjoy, or lingering fatigue.
explore.burnoutDesc: Mental exhaustion, cynicism, boundary challenges, and reduced sense of accomplishment.
explore.transitionsDesc: Navigating relocations, relationship changes, grief, career pivots, or identity shifts.

specialists.title: Meet our clinical specialists.
specialists.subtitle: Registered psychiatrists and licensed clinical psychologists holding statutory credentials from NMC and RCI.
specialists.noMatchDesc: Try choosing 'All' or searching for another specialty.

howItWorks.title: How Manospring works.
howItWorks.subtitle: From initial exploration to ongoing clinical care, every step is designed to be calm, confidential, and completely within your control.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Reflect on what you are experiencing with our Personal Wellness Guide or browse topics at your own pace without pressure.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Select from verified psychiatrists (MD/DNB) and licensed clinical psychologists (M.Phil, RCI) based on your needs and language preferences.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Choose an available time slot and select your consultation format—encrypted HD video, audio phone call, or secure private messaging.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Join your private consultation suite. Work collaboratively with your specialist to receive an evidence-informed care and recovery plan.

privateSpace.title: A private, confidential space to talk.
privateSpace.p1: Mental health is deeply personal. At Manospring, every interaction—from reflective conversations with our Personal Wellness Guide to 1-on-1 consultations with specialists—is held to the highest ethical and legal privacy standards.
privateSpace.f1Desc: In compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA 2023), you hold full ownership of your data. You may request record access, correction, or permanent erasure at any time.
privateSpace.f2Desc: All consultation rooms, prescriptions, and notes are protected with TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest. Video and audio streams are never recorded without explicit written authorization.
privateSpace.f3Desc: Our Personal Wellness Guide provides active empathetic listening and gentle psychoeducation. It never claims to be a doctor, diagnose medical conditions, or prescribe pharmaceuticals.

nextStep.title: Take the first step towards feeling supported.
nextStep.desc: Professional care is available whenever you feel ready. Consult verified psychiatrists and clinical psychologists privately from home.
